## Cyberdeck.getRackCapacity() method

Get the max number of mod slots available in the cyberdeck mod rack. Includes any extra slots from charged rack extension mods.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getRackCapacity(): number;
```
**Returns:**

number

the maximum number of mods that currently can be installed at once
